source_name: NTA Corporate Number Publication Site (法人番号公表サイト)
rate_limits: Web-API needs a free application ID; bulk download has no auth
notes: Authoritative national register of the 13-digit corporate number for ~5M entities. Fully open bulk (national/per-prefecture, CSV SJIS/Unicode/XML). Verified: downloaded Tottori 31_tottori_all_20260529 (20,153 rows, 30 cols). Identity only — NO financials/capital/officers/industry. Bulk download is a public form POST (CSRF token + session; no access control bypassed).

rate_limits: API v2 requires a free Subscription-Key (registration); v1 retired (HTTP 403)
notes: Authoritative financials for listed & disclosure-obligated companies (有価証券報告書 etc.) as XBRL. documents.json returns 401 without a free Subscription-Key. Joins to NTA via the corporate number (JCN) exposed in filer metadata. Free key, no payment; data is public disclosure.

organization: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (経済産業省)
rate_limits: REST API requires a free token (利用申請 → APIトークン); returns 500 without it
notes: Official METI aggregator keyed on the corporate number. Enrichment: capital, employees, business summary, 財務情報 (financial info), procurement (調達), subsidies (補助金), certifications, patents. Free token required; gov standard terms of use (≈ CC-BY). Bulk CSV download also offered.

source_name: Registry Information Service (登記情報提供サービス) / Legal Affairs Bureau
organization: Ministry of Justice (法務省) / 法務局
notes: The full commercial register (officers, capital, purpose, history). Pay-per-record view; no open bulk/API. Cataloged from public documentation only — the source of officer/capital data not in NTA. Verify terms before any use.
